Cold Food Storage Chart

Follow the guidelines below for storing food in the refrigerator and freezer to keep it tasty and safe to eat.

Food Type Refrigerator (40 °F or below) Freezer (0 °F or below)
SaladEgg, chicken, ham, tuna, and macaroni salads3 to 4 daysDoes not freeze well
PoultryChicken or turkey, whole1 to 2 days1 year
LeftoversCooked meat or poultry3 to 4 days2 to 6 months
